The '''Lake of the Unseen''' was a lake located in the northeastern corner of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], east of the [[Darkstone Grove]]. Favored by native [[Vorantikus|vorantiki]], the Lake was home to at least three enormous vorantiki&mdash;[[Qusak]], [[Sorak]], and [[Drumond]]&mdash;during the [[Galactic War]]. Despite the wildlife and corruption from the [[Dark Heart]], a group of [[Voss Mystics]] could be found meditating at a damaged shrine in the lake, by which they were able to reach the [[Spirit World]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lake of the Unseen appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
